name: Forgot Password — reset password form renders and validates

planSteps.description: The page displays a heading containing 'كلمة المرور' or 'Password' or 'نسيت'
An email input field is visible for entering the account email
A submit button with text like 'إرسال' or 'Send' or 'استعادة' is visible
Click the submit button without entering an email
An error message or validation indicator appears, indicating the email field is required
